evaluationBasis: First render in Slipware with the accepted renderer semantics and unchanged theme tokens; evaluated at full lab, exact 1920 montage-cell, 390 CSS px, and 1160 px wide scales.

categoricalScene.notes: At lab and 1160 px scales all ten full labels, individual observations, and median rules are immediately readable. The exact current montage cell preserves group order, point/median structure, and uniquely recognizable visibly ellipsized labels, but requires more effort than either accepted distribution panel. The 390 px lab presentation uses a taller evidence box; the source and accessibility table retain every full category name.
categoricalScene.reasonNoAlternateTheme: Slipware gives sufficient contrast and keeps the evaluation centered on categorical structure; no material theme weakness was reproduced.

treatment_replicates.addsCapability: The candidate demonstrates twice as many ordered groups, multi-word labels, and a denser categorical axis while retaining one shared observation identity.
treatment_replicates.editorialTradeoff: The extra range is real, but at montage scale it replaces Treatment's immediate five-group read with visibly ellipsized labels and higher inspection effort.

paired_seasonal_distributions.addsCapability: The candidate tests ten positional groups with one semantic series; Seasonal habitat distributions instead tests two semantic series within four groups.
paired_seasonal_distributions.editorialTradeoff: The scenes are structurally complementary. The candidate does not replace the within-group comparison that makes Seasonal useful.

montageDecision.reason: The candidate is usable rather than strong at the exact montage-cell scale, so the authorization threshold for an alternate montage was not met.

discoveredIssue.before: At 362 × 218 CSS px, the fixed 120 px plot minimum overrode the measured rotated-label reservation and produced a -60.105 px plot-to-x-tick gap in Chromium (-60.060 px in Firefox).
discoveredIssue.fix: Cap the internal minimum plot height by the height actually available above the measured tick/title/footer bands; no contract, renderer, theme, or typography API changed.
discoveredIssue.after: The original compact boundary and the taller 390 px candidate presentation both have positive plot/tick, tick/title, title/provenance, and y-title/tick gaps in Chromium and Firefox.
discoveredIssue.regressionAssertion: run-specimen-audit.cjs temporarily exercises the original 116:70 compact boundary and fails if plotToXTicks is non-positive.

heldBoundary: No alternate montage was produced. No renderer API, theme token, palette capacity, marker glyph, series-capacity claim, package, release, navigation, or deployment surface was added.
